content: Diffusers docs: full reproducibility across hardware is not guaranteed because GPU matmul is less deterministic than CPU; seeds are not portable across GPU architectures; CPU vs GPU differ with identical seeds. On Apple MPS: Dropout nondeterministic (pytorch 84516), training nondeterministic (97236), MPS generators produced black images so CPU generators are used, and first-pass results differed from later passes requiring warmup on PyTorch 1.13.
